# Quick start

## Julia

ConScape is a library for the [Julia programming language](https://julialang.org/).

\note{For a [comparison between Julia and R](https://datascience-enthusiast.com/R/R_Julia_cheat_sheet.html) 
for basic matrix and vector notations.}

### Installation

Julia can be installed [here](https://julialang.org/installation/).

::: {.callout-warning}
ConScape requires a Julia version **≥ 1.9**
:::

### Running

VS Code is widely used, especially in the Julia community.
It is easy to set up and use as shown [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oi5dZxPGNlk).

## Installing ConScape

To install ConScape from Julia's repl type `]` for pkg mode and:

```julia-repl
`add ConScape`
```

Now you are ready to start with the first
[notebook](/notebooks/nbk_getting_started.qmd) presenting a basic workflow for
connectivity analysis using ConScape.
